translations.web: He said, “Don’t come close. Take off your sandals, for the place you are standing on is holy ground.”
translations.bsb: “Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
